critical_code_review_comments: PtMapper.tsx (383 lines) is under the 700-line file-size threshold but already contains 3 page components (PtMapperPage/PtFileDetailPage/ReviewQueuePage) + ReviewRow; consider splitting per-route file for future maintainability.
PtFileDetailPage exportCsv() does not show loading/error state; if the blob download fails network-side the user gets no feedback. Minor; non-blocking.

ReviewQueuePage fetches 9 controlled-vocabulary endpoints sequentially via Promise.all on mount with no loading indicator for vocab; user can race-click resolve before options populate. Mitigated in practice by 3s settle time, but a vocab-loaded flag would be safer.
Taxonomy resolve has no client-side validation - user can click Resolve with all selects empty (backend may 400). Consider disabling button until at least item is chosen.

All required data-testid attributes are present and correctly named (pt-upload-dropzone, pt-files-table, review-queue-link, ptfile-rerun, ptfile-export, ptfile-rows-table, ptfile-unresolved-banner, ptfile-ready-banner, review-list, review-item-<id>, review-target-<id>, review-resolve-<id>, review-ignore-<id>, tx-item/sub/type/gender/fit/pattern-<id>). Excellent testability.
